c: Peel and grate papaya; salt 1 h; squeeze very dry.
Julienne carrot, pepper, ginger; slice onion and garlic.
Boil vinegar, sugar and pepper; cool slightly.
Pack vegetables and raisins; pour brine over; mature 0–3 °C 3 days.
d3311e12.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

c: Quarter cabbage; salt between leaves; rest 6 h turning twice; rinse; drain.
Blend pear, onion, garlic, ginger with water; strain; season with sugar and 15 g salt.
Stuff leaves with julienned daikon, carrot, spring onion.
Pack; pour liquid to cover; ferment 18–20 °C 2 days; chill.
5fff7a55.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.
5fff7a55.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan; no fish sauce.

c: Peel beetroot; cut 2 cm cubes (not grated).
Cover with 1 % salt brine and sliced ginger in a jar.
Boil eggs 9 min; chill; peel (20 eggs).
Simmer vinegar, water, sugar, salt, spices and sliced beetroot 10 min; cool to room temperature.
Pack eggs with onion; pour liquor over.
Refrigerate 3 days before serving; use within 3 weeks.
991cc0f5.st: Always refrigerated 0–3 °C; max 3 weeks; never stored at room temperature.
991cc0f5.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar)

c: Cultured cream starter (crème fraîche or live buttermilk)
Stir starter into cream; culture 20–22 °C 18–24 h until thick and tangy.
Chill to 12 °C; whip in mixer until butter separates; drain buttermilk (keep).
Wash butter in iced water until it runs clear; knead out water.
818c7174.st: Butter 0–3 °C 3 weeks or frozen 3 months; buttermilk 0–3 °C 7 days.

c: Shred cabbage; julienne carrot; slice onion and jalapeño thinly.
Massage with 2 % salt and oregano until wet.
Pack under weight; ferment 20 °C 4–7 days to taste.
Serve with pupusas, tacos, grilled meats.
bf5ac0fa.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.

c: Pack upright with garlic, dill, chilli, mustard seeds.
Boil vinegar, water, salt; pour over leaving 1 cm headspace; seal.
3dc9a418.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

c: Pack with sliced ginger, garlic, dill; cover with brine; weight.
679b52b6.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.

c: Cover completely with raw honey in a jar ⅔ full; loose lid.
Turn jar daily; burp; ferment 20 °C 4 weeks until honey is runny and garlic mellow.
d07dc80b.st: Ferments 4 weeks at 20 °C; then cool dry store 12 months. Check pH ≤ 4.6 before use; not for infants under 1 year.

c: Destem chillies (gloves); pulse with garlic and 3 % salt of total weight to a coarse mash.
Pack in jar; press to release liquid; top with 300 ml 3 % brine; airlock.
Blend with vinegar and sugar; pass through fine sieve; bottle.
d9720235.st: Bottled 0–3 °C up to 6 months; pH ≤ 3.8 required.

c: Peel young ginger; shave paper-thin along the grain.
Salt 30 min; blanch 30 s; drain well.
Boil vinegar and sugar; pour over hot ginger.
Chill 2 days (turns pale pink with young ginger).
ac74fc5c.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

c: Ginger bug: 30 g grated ginger + 30 g sugar + 250 ml water; feed daily 5 days until fizzy.
Wort: simmer 150 g grated ginger with 2.5 L water 15 min; dissolve 300 g sugar; cool; add lemon juice.
Carbonate 2–3 days at room temperature; burp; chill.
b0867500.st: Bottle in pressure-rated swing-top bottles; burp daily during carbonation; then 0–3 °C max 3 weeks. Contains < 1.2 % alcohol.

c: Remove outer leaves (keep 2); quarter, core and shred cabbage 2 mm; weigh.
Massage with 2 % salt (20 g/kg) 10 min until brine forms; mix in spices.
Pack tightly into crock; brine must cover; top with whole leaves and a weight.
f518fbce.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.

c: Slice jalapeños in rounds or slit whole; carrots in diagonal coins; onion in petals.
Fry garlic, onion and carrot in oil 3 min.
Add vinegar, water, herbs, salt, sugar; boil; add jalapeños 2 min until olive-green.
3799965e.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

c: Peel daikon; cut 2 cm cubes; toss with salt and sugar; rest 45 min; drain (do not rinse).
Cook rice flour with water to a paste; cool.
Mix paste with gochugaru, fish sauce, garlic, ginger; coat radish; add spring onion.
Pack; ferment 20 °C 1–2 days until sour; chill.
a04b9237.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.

c: Brew tea in 1 L boiling water 10 min; strain; dissolve sugar; add remaining cold water (≤ 25 °C).
Add SCOBY and starter (10 %); cover with cloth; ferment 22–25 °C 7–10 days to pH 2.5–3.5.
Keep SCOBY + 400 ml for next batch.
2nd ferment: bottle with grated ginger 2–3 days at room temperature; chill.
5f98df17.st: Bottle in pressure-rated swing-top bottles; burp daily during carbonation; then 0–3 °C max 3 weeks. Contains < 1.2 % alcohol.

c: Scrub cucumbers; trim blossom end (enzymes soften); soak in iced water 1 h.
Pack jar with cucumbers, garlic, dill, spices and tea (tannins keep crunch); cover with brine; weight.
Ferment 18–20 °C: half-sour 4–5 days, full-sour 2–3 weeks; chill.
e1eba52f.st: Ferment as stated at 18–22 °C, weighted under brine, airlock or loose lid; check daily (discard if pink/furry mould, slimy or off-smell). Then 0–3 °C up to 6 months.

c: Add grains to fresh milk in clean jar; cover with cloth.
Ferment 20–22 °C 24 h until thickened and tangy.
Strain grains with plastic sieve; refresh grains in fresh milk.
Chill kefir; second ferment with fruit optional 12 h.
Cut pears and quince into 2 cm pieces; macerate with sugar and lemon 12 h.
Drain syrup; boil 5 min; pour back over fruit; repeat next day.
Cook fruit in syrup with wine and apricots until translucent; add cherries.
Off heat stir in mustard powder (bloomed in a little wine) and seeds; jar hot.

c: Cut cucumbers into 8 cm pieces; split crosswise in an X leaving 1 cm uncut at the base.
Filling: chives, julienne carrot, onion with gochugaru, fish sauce, garlic, ginger, sugar.
Stuff each cucumber; pack; ferment 20 °C 1 day; chill; best within 2 weeks.
a59fdbf7.st: Ferment 1 day at 20 °C, then 0–3 °C max 2 weeks.

c: Rinse seeds; blanch 1 min; drain (removes bitterness); repeat twice.
Simmer seeds with vinegar, water, sugar, salt and bay 40 min until plump and glossy; top up with water.
Peel, quarter and core firm pears.
Boil vinegar, water, sugar, spices and lemon zest 5 min.
Poach pears gently 5–8 min until just tender.
Jar pears; reduce liquor 5 min; pour over; seal.
babc3d59.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

c: Shave fennel 2 mm on mandoline; zest orange in strips.
Warm vinegar, water, sugar, salt, seeds and zest until dissolved; add orange juice.
Pour warm (60 °C) over fennel to keep crunch.
Ready after 1 h; best within 1 week.
Toast rye bread dark (not burnt); pour boiling water over; steep 6 h.
Strain; dissolve sugar; cool to 25 °C; add yeast.
Ferment 20 °C 12–24 h; bottle with 2–3 raisins each.
698f0c63.st: Bottle in pressure-rated swing-top bottles; burp daily during carbonation; then 0–3 °C max 3 weeks. Contains < 1.2 % alcohol.

c: Rub koji between hands to break clumps; mix with salt.
Add water to just cover; stir.
Ferment 22–25 °C 7–10 days, stirring daily, until sweet-savoury and porridge-like.
Blend smooth (optional); use 10 % of protein weight as marinade 12–24 h.
Boil beetroot whole until tender 45–60 min; peel; slice 5 mm.
Boil vinegar, water, sugar, salt and spices 5 min.
Layer beetroot and sliced onion in jars; pour hot liquor over; seal.

Heat vinegar, water, sugar, turmeric and kombu until dissolved; cool.

Dissolve sugar in water; add pineapple and spices; cover with cloth.
Strain; serve chilled over ice (optionally with a splash of lager).
Roast aubergines whole 220 °C 40 min; peel; chop.
Simmer chopped herbs and garlic in 200 ml vinegar 2 min.
Combine all with remaining vinegar, spices and salt into a thick paste.
f2b90bd7.st: Hot-filled sterilised jars, sealed; 0–3 °C up to 3 months; once open 4 weeks.

Strain grains (re-use); bottle with sliced ginger and lemon juice.
Carbonate 24 h at room temperature; chill.
